notes.title: Zero-gravity Combat Meetup
notes.notes:
Hi,

If you own a virtual reality headset and are interested: we are hosting a meetup in our new multiplayer sci-fi game tonight so consider joining.  The event will start today at 9pm pst (Dec.21)  . 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301580/Cyphen/]Cyphen[/url] is free on the Steam store, check it out and leave a review!

[i]Hope to see you there[/i]
